subject: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0500
Subject: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows

Hi Lydia —

Following up on our MAP review last week. We're close on the evaluation plan and want to start a short, repeatable checkpoint to keep momentum and surface any blockers ahead of procurement. Proposal:

- Weekly 30-min MAP checkpoint (standing) for the next 6 weeks
- Focus: progress vs evaluation plan, outstanding open items (security, SOW, infra), and actions/owners
- Rotate the primary owner of the update each week (Redwood / Acme) so decision-makers get concise summaries

To make this painless across time zones: we can keep the meeting at 10:30 AM PT (1:30 PM ET) on Thursdays. I know you have EMEA stakeholders — if that doesn't work we'll do an alternating schedule (one week earlier for EMEA).

I've attached the current MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short agenda template (agenda-template.md). If you confirm an attendee list and preferred cadence, I'll send a calendar hold and the first agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), agenda-template.md (markdown stub)

From: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick note on attendees/timezones: our evaluation team in EMEA (incl. procurement and architecture) can't do 10:30 PT without stretching into late evening. Two options from our side:

1) Keep your Thursday 10:30 AM PT for the core US stakeholders and treat the EMEA participants as optional (they'll get the notes)
2) Alternate the time every other week so EMEA can attend every second checkpoint (e.g., Thu 10:30 PT / Thu 17:30 CET)

For now, option 2 is preferable — alternating weeks. Also request we add Acme Procurement (procurement@acme.com) to the calendar invites so procurement sees timelines and gating items.

Attendees from our side for the recurring invite: Lydia Ramos (evaluation lead), Rafael Mendes (infra), Acme Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — Rafael is in Lisbon so the alternating cadence helps.

Would you be able to propose the alternating schedule and send the calendar holds?

Best,
Lydia
Evaluation Lead — Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows

Karthik — quick internal note:

- Agree with alternating cadence. That will keep EMEA engaged and avoid long late calls.
- I'll volunteer to draft the first two agendas and take owner for week 1 so the rhythm is smooth. Can you confirm which week you want Redwood to own vs Acme?
- We'll include a 5-min quality checkpoint (prompt set pass/fail) to highlight any regressions in the evaluation plan.

Also recommend the calendar invites include the HubSpot deal link and a shared Drive folder link (I've already created the folder at the link below).

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Acme-MAP

Marissa
Senior AE — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows

Thanks all — plan below, I'll send calendar holds (calendar-hold.ics) after this note:

- Cadence: Weekly 30-min checkpoints for 6 weeks, alternating times:
  • Week A: Thu 10:30 AM PT / 1:30 PM ET (US-friendly)
  • Week B: Thu 11:30 AM PT / 17:30 CET (EMEA-friendly) — note shifted one hour to avoid late evening for Lisbon
- Ownership rotation: Redwood leads Week A (owner: Marissa Cole), Acme leads Week B (owner: Lydia Ramos / Rafael Mendes)
- Agenda template: 1) Quick status (5 min) 2) Risks/blockers (10 min) 3) Action items & owners (10 min) 4) Quick Qs / next steps (5 min)
- Deliverables: Updated MAP_v3.xlsx after each checkpoint, and a 1-paragraph decision log for any scope changes

Marissa — thanks for owning week 1 agenda. Grace, can you coordinate the invite and attach the Drive link + HubSpot deal reference? Monica, please ensure the MAP spreadsheet is the canonical source (I'll ask for versioning notes).

I'll draft the first calendar hold and set the alternating recurrence pattern. Expect invites within the hour.

Best,
Karthik

From: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint cadence & attendee re-org — propose weekly sync windows

That looks great — thank you.

Confirmed: Acme will take Week B ownership and Rafael will be added as a recurring attendee. Please add procurement@acme.com to the recurring invite. We'll expect the Drive folder link and the first agenda from Marissa prior to the first meeting.

I'll watch for the calendar hold.

Regards,
Lydia
